definition.def: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand. [approval]
examples: Disposable nappies are fairly straightforward to put on.

definition.def: If you describe a person or their behaviour as straightforward, you approve of them because they are honest and direct, and do not try to hide their feelings. [approval]
examples: She is very blunt, very straightforward and very honest.
I was impressed by his straightforward intelligent manner.
